problems.explain: Each number is the two above it added. The row below starts 1, and its fifth number sits under the fourth and fifth of this row: 10 + 5 = 15. So it is 15.

prompt.v: Multiplied out, (a + b)ⁿ has the coefficients 1, 10, 45, …. What is n?

problems.explain: The coefficients of (a + b)ⁿ are row n of Pascal's triangle, which begins 1, n: the second term is n·aⁿ⁻¹b, one b from any of the n factors (a + b). So n = 10.

prompt.v: A row of Pascal's triangle begins 1, 10, 45, …. What do all the numbers in that row add up to?

problems.explain: A row beginning 1, 10 is row 10, the coefficients of (a + b)¹⁰. Putting a = b = 1 adds them all: (1 + 1)¹⁰ = 2¹⁰ = 1,024. (Each row adds to twice the row above.) So they add up to 1,024.
